lines.t: Yeah… This one’s for the ones still waitin’ to see.
For the ones that need a sign before they believe.
The Lord said — faith don’t need proof. Let’s ride.
I don’t walk by sight, I walk by word,
Ain’t got time for noise, I done already heard.
Got peace in my chest, truth in my hand,
Ain’t need no miracle to make me stand.
When the eyes don’t see and the ears don’t chase,
That’s when trust grow deep, that’s when faith got grace.
Ain’t worry ‘bout tomorrow, it’s already known,
I’m planted in the promise, roots full-grown.
Faith don’t need proof, nah, I’m good where I’m at,
You can keep the signs, I ain’t chasin’ that.
I walk in the way, I move in the Word,
Peace in my path and strength in my verse.
See the one that gotta see? He don’t really trust.
The one with itchy ears? He fall to dust.
But the one who believe, yeah, he free inside,
Ain’t bound to the talk, just the Spirit’s guide.
I done sat in the storm, heart still calm,
Knew the Lord got me, no need for alarm.
My vision internal, my trust complete,
I’m livin’ that walk — that victory sweet.
Faith don’t need proof, nah, I’m good where I’m at,
You can keep the signs, I ain’t chasin’ that.
I walk in the way, I move in the Word,
Peace in my path and strength in my verse.
Faith don’t need proof, nah, I’m good where I’m at,
You can keep the signs, I ain’t chasin’ that.
I walk in the way, I move in the Word,
I walk in the way, I move in the Word,
Peace in my path and strength in my verse.
Ain’t no fear here, I done let that go,
My faith don’t talk, man, my faith just show.
When you trust that deep and you walk that road,
The Lord turn your spirit into solid gold.
Yeah… I don’t wait for the news to drop.
His promise don’t need no headlines.
Faith made complete — walkin’ in the Lord’s time.
